p5_residual_diagnostic_blind_oos.note: best_I4 rank vector is retrospectively best formula within interaction family per target; therefore these residuals are oracle-conditioned and are NOT ex-ante selected model misses.
p5_residual_diagnostic_blind_oos.interpretation: P5 ranks stronger than other positions in oracle-conditioned family results. However, residual tail is substantial: 106/669 ranks >10 and 8/669 ranks >20. Value-bin slices are exploratory and imbalanced; especially 1-10 has only one target. No ex-ante validation.

next_gate: Build formula-specific prior-only position scores/ranks and nested walk-forward selection, then examine P5 misses from the ex-ante selected formula stream.
